{{Top|leg}}
'''Terin Vollen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] to [[Nyreen Vollen]]. Terin disappeared sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and Nyreen, hoping to find out what happened to him, agreed to transport [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Sull]] off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaftikar]] upon the request of [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[A'den Skirata]] in exchange for information on Terin. She was later informed that Terin [[Death/Legends|died]] while traveling in space.<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
